videos.title: How to Calculate Corner Radius Correctly (Inner + Padding)
videos.description:
Stop guessing your corner radius. The correct formula is simple: inner radius plus padding equals outer radius. This keeps nested elements visually consistent across tight, regular, and loose spacing.
